class.name: LightShaftsEffect
class.brief_description: Shafts of sunlight through gaps, towards the sun on screen.
class.description: Shafts of sunlight through the gaps between buildings, trees and clouds, spreading towards the viewer from the sun on screen, in the sun's color. The sun is the brightest [DirectionalLight3D] lighting the scene; with it off screen by more than [member spread], nothing is drawn. Each pixel marches towards the sun counting the open sky it passes, so the shafts follow whatever stands in front of the sky. Add it to a [Compositor]'s [member Compositor.compositor_effects], on a [WorldEnvironment] or [Camera3D]. It's drawn after the scene's see-through objects, before tonemapping, in each view (both eyes in VR), with the Forward+ renderer; with the others it draws nothing.

members.member: Tints the shafts, on top of the sun's own color.
How much each step towards the sun counts after the one before it: lower values make shorter shafts.
The share of the way to the sun each pixel marches.
How many steps each pixel takes towards the sun. More is smoother and costs more.
How far the shafts reach from the sun on screen, in screen heights.
How bright the shafts are, times the sun's color and energy.
